bias_targets.methodology: Aggregating text chunks by author age and projecting the combined embeddings into a 2D space using U-map to observe spatial clustering and sequential ordering of age groups.
Averaging the embeddings of text chunks associated with specific author occupations and projecting them using U-map to observe spatial proximity and similarities between related professions.
Analyzing correlations and making spatial projections of authorship embeddings based on demographic annotations for author gender provided in the dataset.
Projecting document embeddings using U-map to evaluate the correlation between generated authorship features and the specific genre or type of text (e.g., fiction, history, poetry).
